StudyToCert practice VM: open-source software notice

The practice VM runs entirely in your web browser. It is made of:

- v86, an x86 emulator (BSD 2-Clause license, see LICENSE-v86.txt).
- xterm.js, the terminal (MIT license, see LICENSE-xterm.txt).
- SeaBIOS (LGPL-3.0), from the Ubuntu 24.04 "seabios" package.
- The Linux kernel 6.8 (GPL-2.0), built from Ubuntu 24.04's "linux-source-6.8.0" package with the
  configuration in tools/vm/kernel-i386.config of the site's source repository.
- Ubuntu 24.04 (i386) packages including bash, coreutils, util-linux, sudo, shadow (passwd), procps,
  iproute2, vim-tiny, BusyBox and the GNU C library. Each package keeps its own license (mostly GPL,
  LGPL and BSD-style); the exact package versions are listed in SOURCES.txt.

No changes were made to any of these programs' source code. The complete corresponding source code for
every package is published by Ubuntu (the source package with the same name and version as listed in
SOURCES.txt, from archive.ubuntu.com or launchpad.net). The build script that assembles the VM,
tools/vm/build-vm.sh, and the kernel configuration are in the site's source repository.

Written offer: for at least three years from the date in SOURCES.txt, anyone may ask for a copy of the
complete corresponding source code of the GPL-licensed programs in this VM, on a physical medium or by
download, for no more than the cost of distribution, by opening an issue with the site's feedback link.
